test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A circular hole of radius 3 cm is cut out of a rectangular sheet of dimensions 12 cm × 10 cm. Find the remaining area.

(Take ㅠ = 3.14)
solution:
**Given:**

Rectangle = 12 cm × 10 cm

Radius of circular hole = 3 cm

π = 3.14

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

Area of circle = π × r²

Remaining area = Area of rectangle − Area of circle

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area of rectangle = 12 × 10 = 120 cm²

⇒ Area of circle = 3.14 × 3 × 3 = 28.26 cm²

⇒ Remaining area = 120 − 28.26 = 91.74 cm²

**∴ Remaining area = 91.74 cm²**
